text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, by the academy gates...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Oh no! I'm gonna be late, I'm gonna be 
late!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, Falco, you dummy, dummy, dummy. That 
makes three days in a row now—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clonk☆)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Eep!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Owwwww...! Jeez! Where are you looking 
when you run?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry...! Are you hurt anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Cute little pony.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —...*heart flutter*☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki and I went along with Smart 
Falcon's request to act out cliché 
situations in order to hone her 
cuteness...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...! Falco's heart really went 
pit-a-pat just now☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Fuji-san! You're a perfect 
fit for the academy's prince~♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you. You were very cute too, 
Falcon.
choice_data_list:
Sorry for dragging you along, Fuji 
Kiseki...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. If it makes someone happy, and 
if I can literally play a "role" for 
them...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As the entertainer Fuji Kiseki, I couldn't 
ask for any greater happiness.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Thank you, Fuji-san! Falco is 
super happy too♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When all's said and done, Trainer, you had 
fun being the director, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I had to say, though... it felt like it 
lacked a bit of realism when we collided, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because it's acting, that's exactly what I 
want to pursue. I'd like to try a retake, 
what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse it's okay! Expressiveness is 
an Umadol's lifeblood☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What do you think I can do to 
make it feel more realistic?
choice_data_list:
Let's give it even more of everything 
we've got.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Give it even more power...? Got it! Then 
I'll crank up the impact!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san! To bring out my full power, I'm 
gonna take a massive running start!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Rest easy. I won't let Falcon get hurt, 
and of course I won't either."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I understand your concern, but there's no 
point if I'm not at full power!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because the more high-spirited a little 
pony is, the cuter she becomes!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Taaaake thiiis!!! 
I'm-Running-Late-Attaaack!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*lands cleanly!*)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Not a problem at all. As you can 
see, I stuck a magnificent landing.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to charge with such force that it 
sent me flying into the air—how 
magnificent!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
On top of your natural cuteness, you've 
gained power now too, Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ This puts me one step closer to 
becoming a top Umadol--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though it deviated quite a bit from 
polishing her cuteness... Smart Falcon has 
grown tremendously!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Practice over and over...! Got it! Would 
you mind helping me, Fuji-san?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah...... Why, of course!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Until everyone is satisfied—as many times 
as it takes. Throw yourselves right at my 
chest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And now, Take 34—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: *pant, gasp*...! Both of you...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's feeling pretty confident about 
that last take, but what do you think... 
!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh... The beauty of the sunset speaks 
volumes of the time we've spent 
together...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
On top of your natural cuteness, you've 
gained toughness now too, Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ This puts me one step closer to 
becoming a top Umadol—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, a sunset?! Forget being late, this 
is super-duper-duper late~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Still, oh well! No matter what time it 
is, it's practically morning for an 
Umadol☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because, because, an Umadol's greeting is 
always—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's "Good morning!", after all♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if the teacher would 
approve... but Smart Falcon seems to have 
grown considerably.
